about: The matches sim-trace records with --record and checks. Each runs World::new(data, worldSeed, setup) on its stage (`stage`; absent: the Lab's map) with the data of the store, for `ticks` ticks or until the event `until` names. A player's input each tick: a bot's think where the player is a bot (`labBots[i]` names a LAB_BOTS entry; else a match bot at its difficulty); else `masher[i]` (a seeded random masher), `combat[i]` (a seeded player that keeps to the other fighter and fights) or `listed[i]` (each input held from its tick to the next entry's). `calls`: a tutorial's calls into the World, each before the step of the tick it names. `botTrees`: the World holds the bot trees.

matches.name: wheel-combat

matches.name: layout-rise
